stand_ins: prominence gas at 8000 K, 1.3 atomic mass units per hydrogen atom, in pressure balance with the corona
about 12 on the disc at once for the Sun's mean spot coverage, in proportion to spot coverage, at most 60
heights a share of the corona's scale height ([0.05, 0.3] active, [0.2, 1.0] quiescent), lengths [2.0, 6.0] heights, thickness 0.1 of the height
lives: active [0.5, 5.0] supergranule lives, quiescent [1.0, 5.0] turns (sheared apart by differential rotation), slingshot [1.0, 4.0] turns
0.5 of active and 0.3 of quiescent ones erupt at the end, at [0.2, 1.5] of the surface escape speed
brightness: hydrogen-alpha 2.5 Doppler widths wide lit by the diluted disc, other lines 0.5 more; no Thomson-scattered continuum
why: Its field averages about 3031 gauss over the surface; its corona is near 8.7 million K with 1.9e15 particles per cubic metre at its foot and a scale height of 0.3 Sun-widths. Cool gas held in its loops sits 1091 times denser than the corona around it.
About 60.0 prominences at once on average, following its spots: 103 alive in this window.
It spins so fast that gas 2.7 radii out orbits as fast as it turns, inside the 7.9 radii its field holds closed: huge cool clouds are slung round there and flung off.
